itemized.escalation_note: p4 rotated + re-rendered at 200dpi (landscape attachment, rotation +90 CCW - the -90 direction came out upside down for this file); p6 same. Both attachments are BORN-DIGITAL text (crisp, not handwriting), so no further cell crops were needed beyond an 800dpi tight cell crop on the p6 '11/25/3008' date.
itemized.notes: 6 pages: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A FORM carrying only the typed words 'See Attachment' plus the printed TOTAL, p4 the Schedule A ATTACHMENT (LANDSCAPE spreadsheet, born-digital), p5 Schedule B FORM ('See Attachment' + printed TOTAL), p6 the Schedule B ATTACHMENT (LANDSCAPE). Both attachments carry their own column headers and their own printed totals, and both reconcile EXACTLY to the Summary Page. The Schedule A attachment has Address/City/ST/Zip columns that the filer left entirely blank, so donor_city/donor_state are blank for every row by SOURCE ABSENCE (not redaction, not privacy discard). Geometry percentages are given against the PORTRAIT poppler render of p4/p6, so each attachment row is a narrow VERTICAL band on those pages.
